definition: Dorin Comaniciu (born 1964) is a Romanian-American computer scientist.
details: He is Senior Vice President of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Innovation at Siemens Healthineers.
story: Imagine an art restorer who can spot a single cracked tile in a vast mosaic. What your eyes do without thinking, the machine does one careful layer at a time. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. The model looks the way you look at a crowd and finds the one face you know. That pixel-to-meaning climb is Dorin Comaniciu.
